name: clarity-photon-alerts
description: Clarity's Photon messaging agent: iMessage bridge (spectrum-ts) + deepagents/Gemini agent

scripts.agent: cd agent && $( [ -x ~/clarity-venv/bin/python ] && echo ~/clarity-venv/bin/python || ( [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python ) || echo python3 ) -m uvicorn clarity_agent.server:app --port 8001
scripts.agent:setup: cd agent && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: tsx --test test/*.test.ts && cd agent && python3 -m pytest -q
scripts.photo-test: cd agent && $( [ -x ~/clarity-venv/bin/python ] && echo ~/clarity-venv/bin/python || ( [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python ) || echo python3 ) photo_test.py
